newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.02 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.02 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0470 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency of 1.0470 to 1.0520 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.0460 and 1.0510 reais to the dollar.

Despite the 0.1 percent decline in the mini-band today, the local currency fell only 0.02 percent because the real was already trading at a low level on Wednesday, when banks held dollars in anticipation of today's decline in the mini-band.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0520 to the dollar, down 0.02 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to end at 1.080 per greenback.
